Internal helper: the note on a predictor coded as a dichotomy other than 0/1

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_dichotomy_note.Rd

jlm() and jlogistic() (Session 347 wording). Since Session 374 (the remedy-line audit; lean okayed S371) the jdummy() line is offered only where jdummy() would take the variable as it stands: the variable as given – unfiltered, as jdummy() reads it – has two categories, and their dummy names can be made (codes -1 and 1 both give x_1, and jdummy() stops). An expression given as the data, which jdummy() refuses, gets no line either. Without the line the note says what to reach, a 0/1 variable.

Usage

.jst_dichotomy_note(v, coding, x_in, data_name, data_kind)

Arguments

v

Character; the predictor's name.

coding

"1/2" or "other", from .jst_is_dichotomy().

x_in

The variable in the frame as given, before any filter.

data_name

Character; the data frame's name.

data_kind

"name", "place" or "expression".

Value

Character(1), the note.
